\subsection*{You'll want to know: la douche}
\textbf{la douche} — \textquotedblleft{}a shower\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{douche} $\leftarrow$ Italian \emph{doccia}, \textquotedblleft{}a water pipe\textquotedblright{}, from Latin \emph{ductus}, \textquotedblleft{}a leading, a conduit\textquotedblright{}, from \emph{ducere}, \textquotedblleft{}to lead\textquotedblright{} — borrowed. (EtymDB 2.1)
\end{cousinweb}
